program_context.program_directive: Evaluate oral allosteric PCSK9 inhibitors in ASCVD using human genetics, AlphaGenome regulatory variant scoring on GCP, AlphaFold 3 pocket modeling on GCP, and oral macrocycle/small-molecule SAR.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Allosteric C-terminal/catalytic-groove PCSK9 small-molecule inhibition disrupting LDLR EGF-A binding
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Small-molecule engagement of the inter-domain allosteric groove between the PCSK9 catalytic and C-terminal Cys-His-rich domains allosterically destabilizes the LDLR EGF-A interface.

mechanism_of_action.biological_rationale: Avoids the flat EGF-A PPI surface while preserving oral Rule-of-5 hepatocyte permeability.

falsifiable_predictions.test_description: fpocket & AlphaFold 3 co-folding of PCSK9 (PDB 2P4E / Q8NBP7) identifies a cryptic allosteric pocket with druggability score >= 0.50 and ligand ipTM >= 0.70.
falsifiable_predictions.kill_criterion: Druggability score < 0.30 or steric clash across all low-energy conformers.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Oral tricyclic macrocycle PCSK9-LDLR PPI blockade benchmarked against MK-0616 (enlicitide)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Oral tricyclic peptidomimetic macrocycle directly occluding the PCSK9 EGF-A binding patch.

mechanism_of_action.biological_rationale: Direct orthosteric competition with LDLR EGF-A domain.

falsifiable_predictions.test_description: Interface contact mapping on EGF-A binding surface confirms salt-bridge and hydrophobic hot-spot coverage with projected human oral bioavailability.
falsifiable_predictions.kill_criterion: Loss of EGF-A hot-spot engagement or unbound hepatic clearance incompatible with QD oral dosing.

stage0_verification_focus: Verify human LoF cardioprotection (gnomAD, OpenTargets, ClinVar) and rs11591147 (R46L) + liver eQTL/sQTL regulatory architecture via AlphaGenome on GCP.
Compare cryptic small-molecule pocket druggability (IC-001) head-to-head against the flat EGF-A macrocycle interface (IC-002).
